title: The Rooftop Lanterns (Los faroles del balcón)

scenes.title: Allá arriba, en el balcón
scenes.summary: On Friday morning, Graham, Caleb, and Hannah step onto the sunny second-floor courtyard balcony and test the original iron hooks made for festival lantern cords.

scenes.title: Hilos de oro sobre el árbol
scenes.summary: Caleb and Owen stretch warm gold-and-coral lantern cords from the upper balcony to the courtyard shade tree while Tessa directs the symmetry from below.

scenes.title: El gran plano de mesas
scenes.summary: Inside Room 9, Arthur proudly shows Hannah and Evelyn his enormous hand-lettered seating poster for twenty-eight guests and refuses to make a backup copy.

scenes.title: Una repentina ráfaga de viento
scenes.summary: Stepping into the courtyard, a sudden wind gust tangles the overhead lanterns and launches Arthur's giant seating chart straight across the stones.

scenes.title: Flotando en el pilón
scenes.summary: Lifting the soaked poster out of the stone basin, Arthur despairs over the blurred blue cloud while Graham and Tessa talk him back from panic.

scenes.title: Desenredando el cordón de los farolillos
scenes.summary: Back on the upper balcony, Graham and Caleb reel in the twisted lantern lines and add wooden spacer loops so the globes stay steady in any breeze.

scenes.title: Veintiocho pinzas de madera
scenes.summary: At the front desk, Graham pours out sturdy birch clothespins, and Hannah numbers them one to twenty-eight in bold pencil to clip onto heavy cloth napkins.

scenes.title: A prueba de viento y listos
scenes.summary: Just before noon on Saturday, Hannah, Tessa, and Caleb admire the windproof rooftop lanterns and clipped linen tables—all set for six this evening, until the front-desk telephone rings!
